title: FAB Process Improvement Intelligence
capabilities: D01 observational sensitivity with support and rank diagnostics
D02 constrained observed and replicated feasible settings
D04 seeded non-executing factorial experiment proposal
D05 randomized and difference-in-differences study estimates with design gates
Authorized metadata-only MCP capability discovery with non-authorizing exact-schema proposals
dependencies: Python >=3.10 standard-library scientific core and CLI
Optional MCP adapter: official MCP Python SDK 2.3.0 with a 28-wheel, SHA-256-locked macOS ARM64 CPython 3.11 candidate bundle; other platforms are not staged

P4 runs independently; the retained P1 panel contribution is optional and is not a product runtime dependency
